# Free QR Code Generator — No Signup

> A free, privacy-first QR code generator. No account required, no expiry, and nothing you type is ever uploaded — QR codes are generated entirely client-side in the browser.

## Pages

- [QR Code Generator](https://qrcodenosignup.com/): Generate a static QR code from any link or text, free, with no signup. Adjustable error correction level, padding, and export size (64–1024px), plus custom foreground/background colors with a built-in contrast checker. Download as PNG or SVG, or copy directly to the clipboard.

## Facts

- Free, no signup or account required, no watermark
- Generates static QR codes — the content is encoded directly into the code itself, not behind a redirect or tracking service, so codes never expire or get deactivated
- Runs entirely client-side in the browser; nothing typed is uploaded to a server
- Export formats: PNG, SVG, or copy to clipboard
- Adjustable error correction levels: Low, Standard, Strong, Max
- Adjustable quiet zone (padding): None, Small, Standard, Large
- Adjustable export size: 64px to 1024px
